project: AI Recording and YouTube Editing Desktop App

stories.title: Start and reopen a project
stories.story: As a creator, I want to record or import and reopen my work so that I can keep my production in one app.
acceptance_criteria: The library offers Record and Import and reopens saved edits and packaging.
Unsaved or missing-source projects show a recovery action rather than discarding state.

stories.title: Recover denied permissions
stories.story: As a creator, I want to understand and resolve capture permissions so that I can record with the sources I choose.
acceptance_criteria: Only permissions for selected sources are requested.
Denied camera access leaves screen-only or import available.

stories.title: Record separate sources
stories.story: As a creator, I want to record a display, window or region with optional camera and sound so that I can edit each source independently.
acceptance_criteria: Source previews and meters precede countdown and recording.
Pause, resume and stop preserve independent screen, microphone and system-audio tracks.

stories.title: Record two cameras simultaneously
stories.story: As a creator, I want to capture camera A and camera B together so that I can give the editor a genuine second angle.
acceptance_criteria: Distinct device selectors prevent using the same device twice.
A qualified two-camera setup produces independent synchronized camera tracks; unsupported combinations are rejected before capture.

stories.title: Recover an interrupted recording
stories.story: As a creator, I want to recover usable footage after a crash or device failure so that I can avoid losing a take.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery identifies available segments and the affected range.
A disconnected camera does not discard working screen, camera or audio sources.

stories.title: Import and identify media
stories.story: As a creator, I want to import existing videos and assign source roles so that I can use recordings from other devices.
acceptance_criteria: Camera-only, screen-only and combined projects are accepted within supported formats.
Unsupported/corrupt media is identified and flattened imports show missing metadata limitations.

stories.title: Synchronize additional camera footage
stories.story: As a creator, I want to align a separately recorded camera and correct drift so that I can keep speech and angles aligned.
acceptance_criteria: Suggested sync displays confidence and coverage and offers manual calibration.
Without a shared reference the project requires manual alignment instead of claiming automatic success.
Playback remains within one output frame at qualified start/middle/end checkpoints.

stories.title: Select the voice track
stories.story: As a creator, I want to choose one master voice and adjust other audio so that I can avoid doubled speech and balance sound.
acceptance_criteria: Only selected audio sources enter the mix and camera scratch audio is muted by default after master selection.
Level changes, noise cleanup and supplied music can be previewed and reversed.

stories.title: Set an editing brief
stories.story: As a creator, I want to set audience duration and style or use defaults so that I can get a suitable edit without writing a detailed prompt.
acceptance_criteria: Defaults allow Create first cut with no free-text brief.
Duration goals are treated as goals without silently discarding essential or locked content.

stories.title: Receive a complete first cut
stories.story: As a creator, I want to receive an assembled playable candidate so that I can review a video instead of manually executing suggestions.
acceptance_criteria: The candidate contains actual source cuts, view decisions and applicable visual effects.
The summary identifies consequential and uncertain choices with source/output times.

stories.title: Clean pacing without changing meaning
stories.story: As a creator, I want to remove safe fillers and pauses while retaining necessary context so that I can sound natural and remain accurate.
acceptance_criteria: Negation, numbers, meaningful waits and protected ranges remain intact.
Uncertain retakes or story reordering are suggested rather than silently applied.

stories.title: Choose useful views automatically
stories.story: As a creator, I want to switch among screen and available camera angles so that I can make explanations engaging and clear.
acceptance_criteria: The AI uses visible demonstration actions as well as narration.
No selected source lies outside its usable coverage, and manual angle overrides take precedence.

stories.title: Add editable motion and graphics
stories.story: As a creator, I want to use zooms transitions and accurate visual callouts so that I can keep important content visible and engaging.
acceptance_criteria: Zooms, pans, view transitions and text graphics can be adjusted or removed independently.
An overlay does not conceal the designated demonstration target; capture-specific cursor controls are unavailable on metadata-free imports.

stories.title: Insert relevant B-roll
stories.story: As a creator, I want to add supporting footage from my supplied material so that I can illustrate ideas without distracting from the explanation.
acceptance_criteria: Inserted assets show their origin and are trimmed to usable ranges.
Narration remains audible and critical screen steps remain visible.
When no suitable asset exists the edit keeps a clean view and does not report invented B-roll.

stories.title: Correct through transcript and timeline
stories.story: As a creator, I want to correct text and make precise timeline changes so that I can finish without another editing app.
acceptance_criteria: Text corrections and transcript-based cuts are distinct operations.
Trim/split/speed/layout changes are undoable and captions follow the edited timeline.

stories.title: Lock and revise a chosen section
stories.story: As a creator, I want to lock important content and request a local AI revision so that I can keep creative control without rebuilding my edit.
acceptance_criteria: A locked range survives later AI cleanup.
Local regeneration preserves unrelated manual edits and shows an undoable comparison.

stories.title: Caption the finished edit
stories.story: As a creator, I want to review and export captions matching the final video so that I can make speech accessible.
acceptance_criteria: Caption text and timings follow cuts, synchronization and speed changes.
A silent project can proceed without a fabricated transcript or caption file.

stories.title: Mask private content
stories.story: As a creator, I want to conceal a time-bounded region so that I can remove private details before export.
acceptance_criteria: Masks can be placed, timed, resized and previewed.
The mask remains aligned after reframing and does not expose its target in the exported frames.

stories.title: Choose where AI data is processed
stories.story: As a creator, I want to understand and control remote processing so that I can choose what leaves my Mac.
acceptance_criteria: Before an outbound request the product names the provider, data, purpose, cost and known retention terms.
Declining cloud processing leaves recording and manual editing available and sends no project data.

stories.title: Recover slow or failed processing
stories.story: As a creator, I want to leave retry or cancel analysis safely so that I can avoid duplicated work and losing my project.
acceptance_criteria: Processing shows real stages and explains continued work after 30 seconds without a progress update.
Retry reconciles existing remote jobs before initiating duplicate paid work.
A provider failure preserves sources and completed edits.

stories.title: Choose a thumbnail and title pair
stories.story: As a creator, I want to receive thumbnail compositions and suggested titles so that I can package the finished video for YouTube.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct concepts include actual editable thumbnails and grounded title alternatives.
The selected title is within 100 characters and the thumbnail exports to a validated image.
The creator can edit text, crop, colors and layout and preview the pair at small size.

stories.title: Keep packaging consistent with revisions
stories.story: As a creator, I want to know when packaging no longer matches the edit so that I can export a coherent final result.
acceptance_criteria: A material edit marks dependent packaging and timings stale.
Updating derived materials preserves unrelated manual packaging decisions and records the edit revision.

stories.title: Export a complete YouTube package
stories.story: As a creator, I want to export video thumbnail and title together so that I can upload them manually to YouTube.
acceptance_criteria: Success includes a playable MP4, selected thumbnail and title, plus applicable sidecars from one edit revision.
No YouTube login or upload occurs and existing exports are never overwritten silently.
Captions and chapters refer to final output time; invalid chapters become section notes or are omitted explicitly.

stories.title: Recover a partial export
stories.story: As a creator, I want to identify and retry an export failure so that I can finish without starting the project over.
acceptance_criteria: Missing media or insufficient disk space is identified before complete export.
Failure shows completed files as partial and preserves the project for retry.
Complete status is shown only after required files are validated.

stories.title: Manage originals and caches safely
stories.story: As a creator, I want to relink media remove projects and clear derived caches separately so that I can control storage without losing originals.
acceptance_criteria: Relinking restores the intended source and its edits after source identity validation.
Removing a project uses Trash and never deletes externally referenced originals.
Clearing caches does not silently remove data required by unfinished work.

stories.title: Reuse a creator style
stories.story: As a returning creator, I want to reuse colors framing and caption choices so that I can keep future videos consistent.
acceptance_criteria: A saved preset can be named and applied to another project.
Applying a preset does not alter source timing or discard locked manual content.
